blocks.text: LEGAZPI CITY — Public elementary and secondary schools in Oas, Albay, will shift to a class schedule that starts at 6 a.m. and ends at noon starting Monday, Nov.16, to protect learners and school personnel from extreme heat associated with Super El Niño. Oas Mayor Jan Kenneth Trinidad issued Executive Order No. 43, Series of 2026, on Thursday, implementing the temporary adjustment until March 31, 2027, unless modified or revoked. The measure, endorsed by the Oas Local School Board, requires schools to complete in-person classes and outdoor activities by noon, as much as practicable, while allowing alternative learning modalities under Department […]...
